natural_language_query: In Small Cell Lung trials, classify the ICI by target class from its generic name as PD-1, PD-L1, or CTLA-4.
base_sql:
SELECT "NCT", "PubMed ID", "Trial name", "Name of ICI" AS source_value FROM clinical_trials
WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Small Cell Lung';
derivation_notes: Map generic ICI names to PD-1/PD-L1/CTLA-4.
